PoH reset and leader-start message structs.

# Purpose
Defines the data types used to pass Proof of History state into a tile. The `fd_poh_reset` structure stores reset parameters such as the current `timestamp`, completed slot data, block hash and block ID values, tick and slot timing values, and leader scheduling limits. The `fd_poh_begin_leader` structure stores the `slot` and `hashcnt_per_tick` values needed to start leader processing. This header only declares these message formats and includes the shared utility type definitions from `fd_util_base.h`.
